title: VONG (I) Titanium Flame Powered Extraction Device
description:
THE VONG (I) Titanium
NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE
The Vong was already a rock solid platform. But this latest reiteration takes it to another level with its full titanium construction and the ability to take apart and replace the centre sleeve should you wish.
The VONG (I) Titanium Features
Titanium sleeve, with a variety of interchangeable sleeves coming soonThe most durable VonG yetAbility to take apart for easier cleaningSmooth rotation
for
easy-to-control airflowTip has an Adjust-a-Bowl feature that allows you to adjust the size of the dosing chamber to your needs and is ideal for microdosingA form fitting profile that fits comfortably in the handTapered mouthpiece that fits snugly in either 10 or 14mm female water piece openingsCaptive Cap and will fit in any standard size DynaStash or SlimStash
Moving on to the tip. A
Nona notched completely contoured extraction chamber
that doubles as a built in grinder sits atop a
trisected 5 fin profile
. Contained inside the extraction chamber is our two position
Adjust-a-Bowl feature
that allows you to adjust the size of the dosing chamber to your needs.
Finally, a combined
10 and 14mm tapered mouthpiece
seals the deal mating perfectly with water pieces. It is also worth noting that glass to metal connections will eventually leave marks on the connection points on your Vong.
Comes with a Captive Cap and will fit in any standard size DynaStash or SlimStash.
PRODUCT CHARACTERISTICS
Cap
Captive Cap
Condenser
Standard
Midsection
14mm VonG Stem
Total Length
92 mm
Included
1 x THE VONG (I) Titanium
1 x Aluminium Storage Tube
